items.title: Meet MonkeyFit
items.body: A short new name on your Home Screen and a bold kettlebell icon, on iPhone and Watch.

items.title: Maps for your sports
items.body: Ski runs vs lifts, hike and ride profiles with splits, a live trail on your Watch. Start tracking from the iPhone with Track live.

items.title: History and your Progress board
items.body: Every session on one timeline with search. Build Progress your way with widgets and per-sport cards.

items.title: Hyrox ready and a trainer plan
items.body: Race prep that fits all your Hyrox races, paced from your goal time. Plus a new Chest & Back workout in the library.

items.title: Saves itself, safer too
items.body: Edits save on their own with Undo, your profile lives in one place, gym search fixes typos, and sign-in and sync are safer.
